redfin.remarks: Modern & Beautifully Remodeled End-Unit: Spacious Living, Prime Stretch Near Beach & Downtown, In-Unit Laundry. Welcome to this beautifully reimagined end-unit home, tucked into a quiet, tree-lined residential block. Inside, this 1,100+ square foot residence is bathed in natural sunlight, with a bright, comfortable living space, cheerful atmosphere, and an exceptionally functional floor plan. The fully remodeled kitchen features quartz countertops and contemporary finishes, opening onto a generous living area with rich hardwood floors, providing an inviting space for entertaining or simply relaxing at home. The spacious primary suite is a true retreat, highlighted by an exceptionally large walk-in closet providing the storage space you've been looking for. The home offers two full bathrooms , both tastefully updated with marble-look tile, framed mirrors, and sleek modern fixtures. Every detail has been thoughtfully considered to create a home that is comfortable, stylish, and easy to enjoy. As an end unit , the home enjoys extra privacy, added light, and a quieter feel than typical mid-building units. A rare find for Long Beach condos: this unit includes its own in-unit washer and dryer, tucked into a dedicated closet with full plumbing hookups, no more hauling laundry to a shared machine or the laundromat down the street. Situated in one of the most desirable stretches of Long Beach, you are just three blocks from the beach, close enough to catch the ocean breeze, far enough to skip the noise and crowds. Downtown Long Beach's restaurants, coffee shops, and nightlife are a short stroll or bike ride away, giving you the best of both worlds: a calm place to come home to, and a vibrant coastal scene whenever you want it. Bright, beautifully remodeled, spacious, and exceptionally well located, this is a wonderful opportunity for someone looking for a simple, comfortable, and cheerful Long Beach lifestyle.
